_comment: Art in London: a long-term guide, no dates. Tiers are the categories (A museums and public galleries, B commercial galleries, C project spaces, studios, cinemas and print). See docs/GUIDES.md. 伦敦看艺术长期导览：分级就是类别（A 博物馆与公共美术馆，B 商业画廊，C 项目空间、工作室、电影院与印刷）。
title: Art in London: museums, galleries and project spaces.
titleZh: 在伦敦看艺术：博物馆、画廊和项目空间。
subtitle: {items} places to see art, from national museums to small project spaces. Most galleries are free; check what is on before you go.
subtitleZh: {items} 个看艺术的地方，从国家级博物馆到小型项目空间。大多数画廊免费；出发前请先看看正在展出什么。

tiers.name: Museums and public galleries
tiers.text: National and public collections, and art centres.
tiers.textZh: 国家级和公共收藏，以及艺术中心。

tiers.name: Commercial galleries
tiers.text: Galleries that show and sell art: free to visit, with shows that change every few weeks.
tiers.textZh: 展出并出售艺术作品的画廊：免费参观，展览每隔几周更换。

tiers.name: Project spaces, studios, cinemas and print
tiers.nameZh: 项目空间、工作室、电影院与印刷
tiers.text: Smaller and artist-run spaces, studios, a cinema and print.
tiers.textZh: 较小的空间和艺术家自营的空间、工作室、一家电影院，以及印刷。

zones.name: Kensington, Chelsea and West
zones.nameZh: 肯辛顿、切尔西与西伦敦

paras.text: Museums, galleries and project spaces in London. They come from shared Google Maps lists, and each was checked in November 2026 against the venue's own pages and the press.
paras.textZh: 伦敦的博物馆、画廊和项目空间。名单来自几份共享的 Google 地图列表，2026年11月逐一对照了场馆官网和媒体报道。

paras.text: This guide has no dates, and shows change all the time: check what is on before you go.
paras.textZh: 本导览没有固定日期，展览也随时更换：出发前请先看看正在展出什么。

items.text: Museums and public galleries: the big collections and art centres. Commercial galleries: free shows that change every few weeks. Project spaces, studios, cinemas and print: smaller places and artist-run spaces.
items.textZh: 博物馆与公共美术馆：大型收藏和艺术中心。商业画廊：免费展览，每隔几周更换。项目空间、工作室、电影院与印刷：较小的地方和艺术家自营的空间。

items.text: Choose one in the Theme box, or type a name, an artist or a street in Find.
items.textZh: 在“主题”框里选一个，或者在“查找”里输入名字、艺术家或街道。

items.text: Commercial galleries usually open Tuesday to Saturday and close between shows. Museums open every day, some late on one evening a week. Check before you go.
items.textZh: 商业画廊一般周二至周六开放，换展期间闭馆。博物馆每天开放，有的每周有一晚开放到较晚。出发前请先确认。

credits.points: Points: shared Google Maps lists; addresses and details from each venue's own pages and the press
credits.pointsZh: 点位：几份共享的 Google 地图列表；地址和信息来自各场馆官网和媒体报道

defaults.price: Entry prices change: check the venue's own page.
defaults.priceZh: 门票价格会变动，请以场馆官网为准。
